events.factual_description: Roulette presents night two of the Darmstadt at 80 Festival on Friday, December 11, 2026. Doors are at 7:00 PM and the performance begins at 8:00 PM; International Contemporary Ensemble lists the event from 8:00 to 9:30 PM. The program features the New York premiere of Anthony Braxton's Thunder Music, which debuted at Darmstadt in 2023, performed by International Contemporary Ensemble x Tri-Centric personnel, and GBSR Duo performing Karlheinz Stockhausen's Kontakte (1958-60). Roulette frames the two-night festival around the 80th anniversary of the Internationales Musikinstitut Darmstadt Summer Course. Face-value admission is $25 advance, $30 at the door, and $20 student/senior with ID. Roulette states that a free livestream will be available at 8:00 PM and archived afterward.

enrichment.note: Roulette and International Contemporary Ensemble verify the exact date, doors/start time, New York-premiere framing, Darmstadt 80th-anniversary context, complete announced personnel, Stockhausen pairing and authorized ticket destination. GBSR Duo independently lists the December 11 program. The Library of Congress verifies that Thunder Music had its U.S. premiere in Washington on March 8, 2025, preventing the New York premiere from being overstated as a U.S. premiere. No Apple Music ID is inferred.

en.why_it_matters: The live argument is unusually concrete: Braxton's recent Thunder Music reaches New York in an ICE/Tri-Centric realization where performer choice, electronics, voices, and a broad brass-reed-percussion palette are part of the composition's identity, while GBSR answers with Stockhausen's Kontakte. The Darmstadt 80 frame places a living master's current system inside the postwar experimental lineage it keeps extending rather than treating either work as museum repertoire.
en.trip_verdict: If New York is viable that Friday, actively make room for Roulette and let the festival anchor the night. From farther down the corridor, pair it with another strong New York reason rather than turn the New York premiere alone into a one-concert pilgrimage.

es.why_it_matters: El argumento en vivo es muy específico: Thunder Music, uno de los sistemas recientes de Braxton, llega a Nueva York en una realización de ICE/Tri-Centric donde las decisiones de los intérpretes, la electrónica, las voces y una paleta amplia de metales, cañas y percusión forman parte de la identidad de la obra; GBSR responde con Kontakte de Stockhausen. El marco de los 80 años de Darmstadt coloca un sistema actual de un maestro vivo dentro de la tradición experimental de posguerra que sigue extendiendo, en vez de tratar cualquiera de las dos obras como repertorio de museo.
es.trip_verdict: Si Nueva York es viable ese viernes, le haría espacio activamente a Roulette y dejaría que el festival organice la noche. Desde más abajo del corredor, lo combinaría con otra razón fuerte para estar en Nueva York en vez de convertir el estreno neoyorquino, por sí solo, en un viaje de un concierto.
